title: More detailed information can be found on the associated SRU bugs at
description:
More detailed information can be found on the associated SRU bugs at
LP: #2152147 and LP: #2152839.

These changes fix both bugs on Resolute for LLVM 22.

======================
Description of changes
======================
I have fixed LP: #2152147 by fixing clang's search logic. Currently,
clang searches in the wrong place for WASM preview targets' compiler
builtins. compiler-rt's installation path is OK, but clang's search
path is not. Luckily, the upstream LLVM team have already solved this
problem for targets like SunOS and OpenBSD--the upstream LLVM team
explicitly maps these targets to their proper directory name. My patch
simply adds the WASM preview targets to the list of overridden targets.
This problem still exists upstream and in Debian--I have forwarded my
fix to both places[1][2].

I have fixed LP: #2152839 by cherry-picking two commits which are
already in 26.10 and Debian. Currently, python3-lldb-22 contains a
broken symlink which gets fixed by adding the missing 'native' subdir to
the paths for both the symlinks themselves[3] and the place which
debian/rules places the Python extensions in the first place[4].

[1]: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/200501
[2]: https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1138702
[3]: https://salsa.debian.org/pkg-llvm-team/llvm-toolchain/-/commit/36e8ff638f7ea8789aa1d2bd821a0f28f3669f7c
[4]: https://salsa.debian.org/pkg-llvm-team/llvm-toolchain/-/commit/3a45e3eda0e442b95eb8dc86de882cf3f08c560d

===
PPA
===
The package builds for all architectures in a PPA:
https://launchpad.net/~maxgmr/+archive/ubuntu/llvm-toolchains/+sourcepub/18437958/+listing-archive-extra

============
autopkgtests
============
Currently, amd64 and arm64 autopkgtests are failing in a PPA, while the
other tests pass:
 - amd64: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-resolute-maxgmr-llvm-toolchains/resolute/amd64/l/llvm-toolchain-22/20260605_144759_21d6c@/log.gz
 - arm64: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-resolute-maxgmr-llvm-toolchains/resolute/arm64/l/llvm-toolchain-22/20260605_145055_9aeaa@/log.gz
 - armhf: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-resolute-maxgmr-llvm-toolchains/resolute/armhf/l/llvm-toolchain-22/20260605_144519_37b86@/log.gz
 - ppc64el: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-resolute-maxgmr-llvm-toolchains/resolute/ppc64el/l/llvm-toolchain-22/20260605_144852_c2362@/log.gz
 - s390x: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-resolute-maxgmr-llvm-toolchains/resolute/s390x/l/llvm-toolchain-22/20260605_154305_5837f@/log.gz

This is not a regression. In fact, as shown by the autopkgtest page
(https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/packages/llvm-toolchain-22),
llvm-toolchain-22 has *never* passed an autopkgtest on *any*
architecture in 26.04. While we naturally want the autopkgtests to be
useful, fixing them is outside of the scope of this particular merge.

diff --git a/debian/patches/fix-wasi-path-search.patch b/debian/patches/fix-wasi-path-search.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f173fcf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/fix-wasi-path-search.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+Description: Fix path lookup for WASI previews
+ getOS() returns the wrong path for WASI preview targets (wasm-wasip1,
+ wasm-wasip2, and wasm-wasip3). For example, passing
+ --target=wasm32-wasip1 returns "wasip1". However,
+ libclang-rt-22-dev-wasm32 installs wasm32 compiler-rt builtins under
+ the "wasi" directory, not the "wasip1" directory, meaning that the
+ toolchain is unable to find the builtins it needs.
+ .
+ This patch makes getOS() return the "wasi" directory when any WASI
+ preview target is used, allowing the toolchain to find the proper wasi
+ builtins.
+Author: Max Gilmour <max.gilmour@canonical.com>
+Bug: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/200500
+Bug-Debian: https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1138702
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/llvm-toolchain-22/+bug/2152147
+Forwarded: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/200501
+Last-Update: 2026-06-02
+---
+--- a/clang/lib/Driver/ToolChain.cpp
++++ b/clang/lib/Driver/ToolChain.cpp
+@@ -717,6 +717,10 @@
+     return "sunos";
+   case llvm::Triple::AIX:
+     return "aix";
++  case llvm::Triple::WASIp1:
++  case llvm::Triple::WASIp2:
++  case llvm::Triple::WASIp3:
++    return "wasi";
+   default:
+     return getOS();
+   }
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
index 00aa7fa..459893d 100644
--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -141,3 +141,4 @@ disable-omptest.diff
 
 # only apply this patch for Ubuntu 25.10 or newer
 ubuntu-clang-use-RVA23U64-profile.patch
+fix-wasi-path-search.patch
diff --git a/debian/python3-lldb-X.Y.links.in b/debian/python3-lldb-X.Y.links.in
index cbda536..46f472e 100644
--- a/debian/python3-lldb-X.Y.links.in
+++ b/debian/python3-lldb-X.Y.links.in
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 # symlink to the library, not the .so symlink
-usr/lib/@DEB_HOST_MULTIARCH@/liblldb-@LLVM_VERSION@.so.1      @LLVM_LIBDIR@/@PYTHON3@/site-packages/lldb/_lldb@PY_EXT_SUFFIX@
+usr/lib/@DEB_HOST_MULTIARCH@/liblldb-@LLVM_VERSION@.so.1      @LLVM_LIBDIR@/@PYTHON3@/site-packages/lldb/native/_lldb@PY_EXT_SUFFIX@
 
 # make the whole package known to the system Python
 @LLVM_LIBDIR@/@PYTHON3@/site-packages/lldb/ usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/lldb
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 0ce35ed..7ad7375 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -1889,17 +1889,17 @@ override_dh_python3:
 ifneq (,$(filter python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION), $(packages)))
 	-find debian \( -name '_lldb*.so' -o -name 'liblldb*.so*' \) -ls
 	: # need the extension be present before calling dh_python3
-	mkdir -p debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb
-	rm -vf debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/_lldb$(PY_EXT_SUFFIX)
+	mkdir -p debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/native
+	rm -vf debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/native/_lldb$(PY_EXT_SUFFIX)
 	cp $(DEB_INST)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/liblldb-$(LLVM_VERSION).so.1 \
-		debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/_lldb$(PY_EXT_SUFFIX)
+		debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/native/_lldb$(PY_EXT_SUFFIX)
 	dh_python3 -v -p python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION) \
 		/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb
 	-ls debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION).p*.debhelper
 	-cat debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION).substvars
 	-find debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)
 	: # remove, symlink created later by dh_link
-	rm -vf debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/_lldb$(PY_EXT_SUFFIX)
+	rm -vf debian/python3-lldb-$(LLVM_VERSION)/$(LLVM_DIR)/lib/$(PYTHON3)/site-packages/lldb/native/_lldb$(PY_EXT_SUFFIX)
 endif
 ifneq (,$(filter python3-clang-$(LLVM_VERSION), $(packages)))
 	dh_python3 -v -p python3-clang-$(LLVM_VERSION)
